No option can be put forward yet because the model could not assess your “monthly churn < 4%” limit.

- The comparison itself held up under the changes tested, but its result is based largely on Olumi’s provisional inputs, including Pro subscriber count, monthly conversions, churn and other-plan MRR.
- The model ranks outcomes by higher MRR because the objective direction was not explicitly specified; it also cannot currently align the £20k/month threshold with its projected change scale.
- The ordering is especially exposed to the assumed price-to-MRR relationship; this is a modelled relationship, not observed pricing evidence.
